summary: The root سبط (sbT) primarily describes something lank or straight, especially hair, as opposed to curly. It can also refer to a person who is tall, well-proportioned, or has long fingers.
lane: سَبِطٌ ذ and and , (the first and third of these in one copy of the S, and the second alone in another copy of the S, and all in the M and Msb and K,) the first of the dial. of El- Hijáz, (TA,) from سَبِطَ , and the second from سَبُطَ , the last being an inf. n. used as an epithet, (Msb,) Lank, not crisp; (S, M, * Msb, K; *) applied to hair: (S, Msb:) pl. سِبَاطٌ , which is said by Sb to be of the measure most common for a pl. of an epithet of the measure فَعَلٌ , (M,) or فَعْلٌ . (TA.) -b2- سَبِطُ الشَّعَرِ , (S, M,) and , (M,) A man having lank hair: (S, M:) and in like manner سِبَاطٌ , alone, applied to a number of persons. (TA.) is also metonymically applied to (tropical:) A foreigner, like as [its contr.] جَعْدٌ is to an Arab. (TA.) -b3- سَبِطٌ also signifies Tall; (M, K;) applied to a man: (M:) or, as also , (TA,) or سَبِطُ الجِسْمِ , (M,) so applied, long in the [ bones called ] أَلْوَاح [pl. of لَوْح ], (M, TA,] and even therein: (TA:) or سَبِطُ الجِسْمِ or , (accord. to different copies of the K,) or both, (S, TA,) goodly in stature, or person, or proportion, (S, K,) and evenness. (S.) Also Having extended limbs, and perfect in make. (TA.) And سَبِطُ القَصَبِ , and , A man [ long and even, or] extended, and without protuberances, in the bones of the fore arms and the shanks. (TA.) And سَبِطُ البَنَانِ and , (tropical:) Long in the fingers. (TA.) And سَبِطُ الخَلْقِ A man lank in make: (L in art. رد :) and سَبِطَةُ الخَلْقِ , and , (tropical:) a woman lank, or soft, or tender, in make. (M, Z, TA.) And سَبِطُ السَّاقَيْنِ A man soft, or flaccid, or uncompact, in the shanks. (Ham p. 238.) -b4- اليَدَيْنِ , (M, K, TA,) and سَبِطُهُمَا , (TA, and so in the CK,) and سَبِطُ الكَفَّيْنِ , (TA,) (tropical:) A man who is liberal, bountiful, or munificent. (M, K, TA.) And سَبِطٌ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ (tropical:) A man easy, or facile, in beneficence. (M, TA.) -b5- مَطَرٌ سَبِطٌ , (Sh, TA,) and , (Sh, K,) (tropical:) Rain pouring abundantly and extensively, (Sh, K,) and consecutively. (Sh, TA.)
